CREATE TABLE configuration (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE evidence (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id), evidence_id TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id, evidence_id))
CREATE TABLE findings (run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(run_id, ordinal))

CREATE TABLE receipts (
 id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, receipt_hash TEXT NOT NULL, record_id TEXT REFERENCES records(id),
 received_at TEXT, raw TEXT NOT NULL, error TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL
)
CREATE TABLE runs (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, balance_at TEXT NOT NULL, knowledge_at TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_configuration_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON configuration BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only table'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_configuration_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON configuration BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only table'); END

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_evidence_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON evidence BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only table'); END

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_receipts_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON receipts BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only table'); END

CREATE TRIGGER immutable_records_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON records BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only table'); END
CREATE TRIGGER immutable_runs_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON runs BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'append-only table'); END
